sources.title: Mount Everest
sources.text: Mount Everest is Earth's highest mountain above sea level, located in the Mahalangur Himal sub-range of the Himalayas. Its elevation of 8,848.86 m (29,031.7 ft) was most recently established in 2020 by Chinese and Nepali authorities. The China-Nepal border runs across its summit point. Edmund Hillary and Tenzing Norgay made the first official ascent on 29 May 1953. The mountain was named after Sir George Everest, the Surveyor General of India from 1830 to 1843. In Nepali it is called Sagarmatha ("forehead of the sky"). Climbers usually take 6 to 9 weeks, e.g. to acclimatise at Base Camp (5,364 m).

sources.title: Ocean acidification
sources.text: Ocean acidification is the ongoing decrease in the pH of the Earth's ocean. Between 1950 and 2020, the average pH of the ocean surface fell from approximately 8.15 to 8.05. Carbon dioxide (CO2) emissions from human activities, e.g. burning coal, oil and gas, are the main cause. Seawater is slightly basic (pH > 7), so the process is a shift toward neutral rather than a change to acidic water. Today the surface ocean has a mean pH of about 8.1. Shell-building organisms such as oysters, clams and corals are harmed because carbonate ions become scarcer.

sources.text: Replacing a washing machine drain pump takes about 45 minutes. Step 1: Unplug the machine and turn off both water taps. Step 4: Disconnect the hoses and the wiring plug, then unscrew the pump. Step 5: Fit the new pump and test for leaks on a short rinse cycle. Never run the machine with the panel off.
